summary.title: Threat Model for TDT4237
summary.description:
* manage the bookings and logistics of a luxury resort.
* guarantee discretion for all of the guests, who often register under pseudonyms in the system
* keep accurate guest information in order to manage billing, as well as keeping track of food preferences, personal requests and special room service
* manage surveillance data from the resort premises to detect unwanted intruders. 
          * AI-based facial recognition should be used to map people in video recordings with legit guests and staff members in the system.

data.name: Internet Boundary
data.description: Separates the Internet from the internal network

data.name: Guest
data.description: books trips/stays and makes requests to the system

data.name: Staff/Employee
data.description: provide concierge services and room service

threats.title: JWT token forgery
threats.description: An attacker steals or forges JWT tokens to impersonate a legitimate guest or staff member, gaining unauthorized access to the system.

threats.title: Overprivileged JWT scope
threats.description: A contractor or integration service account exploits insufficiently scoped JWT tokens from the external IdP to access admin-level functions not intended for their role. (should be elevation of privilege, but does not show up)

threats.title: Request flooding
threats.description: An attacker overwhelms the booking system with a high volume of requests, preventing legitimate guests from making or managing reservations.
threats.mitigation: Proper request throttling and reverse proxies

threats.title: Charge dispute
threats.description: A guest disputes having made a booking or incurred charges, and the system lacks sufficient evidence to prove the transaction occurred.
threats.mitigation: Provide remediation for this threat or a reason if status is N/A

data.name: Orders
data.description: Processes room service and other guest orders

data.name:
Facial
recognition
engine
data.description: Performs the facial recognition data on surveillance footage

threats.title: Face spoofing
threats.description: An adversary uses a photograph, mask, or deepfake to fool the facial recognition system into identifying them as a registered guest or staff member.

threats.title: Training data poisoning
threats.description: An attacker with access to the facial recognition training pipeline injects manipulated data to cause targeted misclassifications, such as allowing an intruder to pass as a guest.

data.name:
Media 
Linker
data.description: Identity resolver (connects footage to guest identities)

threats.title: Identity-media linkage leakage
threats.description: A low-privileged staff user exploits weak authorization in the Media Linker API to enumerate mappings between surveillance subjects and real guest identities, bypassing the pseudonymization boundary.

threats.title: Linkage key inference
threats.description: An attacker exploits deterministic and reversible linkage keys between the pseudonymized and identity databases to infer real identities without direct database access.

data.name: write
data.description: Store real guest information (PII, billing details)

data.name: req
data.description: Retrieve real billing details for charges

threats.title: Unauthorized access without audit trail
threats.description: A staff member accesses sensitive guest PII in the guest info database and denies having done so due to insufficient logging and audit mechanisms.

threats.title: Privilege escalation to PII
threats.description: A staff account exploits weak access controls to escalate privileges and directly query the guest info database, bypassing the pseudonymization boundary. (should be elevation of privilege, but does not show up here)

threats.title: SQL injection
threats.description: An attacker exploits insufficient input validation to inject malicious SQL queries, modifying pseudonym-to-identity mappings in the database.

threats.title: Footage interception
threats.description: Surveillance footage is intercepted in transit between cameras and the media database due to unencrypted communication channels on the surveillance network.
threats.mitigation: Proper network segmentation and enforce encryption
